title: Complete iros2j 1.0.1 and release v2.1.0.1

estimates.basis: Cold-start release-engineering estimate; no completed iros2j per-package release samples exist.

operations.summary: Established GitHub/ClickUp task workflow and cross-session startup protocol.
Implemented iros2j package generation, source lock, APT, SBOM, and gates.
Added ClickUp timer/estimate rules, historical metrics, calibration, error records, and completion reports.
ScrumNEO was not present in the linked task, comments, attachments, linked work, workspace search, repository, or GitHub Issue.
Defined the Indra Workspace status lifecycle, checkpoint comment rules, verification, and connector fallback.
Added preparation for supporting work and distinguished it from analysis, planning, and direct implementation.
Validated the exact origin/main checkpoint before native ARM64 dispatch.

operations.evidence: No IROS2_SSH_* environment variables, SSH host alias, local gpg command, or builder GPG key configuration was available.
operations.summary: Native execution requires the Debian 13 ARM64 SSH target and release GPG key ID.
Verified Debian 13 Trixie aarch64 builder access, kernel 6.18.34+rpt-rpi-2712, GnuPG 2.4.7, and non-interactive sudo.

operations.evidence: No secret keys were returned from either the rpi or root GPG keyring.
operations.summary: A release signing key must be imported or created before the native pipeline can produce signed APT metadata.

errors.symptom: All 251 ROS packages compiled successfully, but Debian packaging treated gmock_vendor as an external rosdep key unsupported on Debian Trixie.
errors.root_cause: The inventory discovered isolated prefixes only through share/ament_index; six valid vendor packages intentionally omit that directory.
errors.correction: Discover isolated packages by their installed package.xml and classify their dependencies as internal.
errors.prevention: Regression-test an internal vendor package without an ament-index directory.

errors.symptom: After the packaging failure, the dispatcher could not write the native run exit-code record.
errors.root_cause: The exit-code path was relative and the worker subshell had changed into the cloned repository.
errors.correction: Resolve the remote run root to an absolute path before entering the worker subshell.
errors.prevention: Require dispatcher regression coverage for an absolute exit-code destination.

errors.symptom: Packaging next stopped on gz-cmake3, and a full preflight found 11 rosdep keys without Debian Trixie mappings.
errors.root_cause: Package groups, source-bundled Gazebo libraries, and an optional proprietary RTI backend were incorrectly treated as mandatory external Debian runtime packages.
errors.correction: Exclude group identifiers, bundled Gazebo payload, and optional RTI Connext from hard Debian Depends.
errors.prevention: Preflight every unique external key and regression-test each non-system dependency category.

errors.symptom: dpkg-deb rejected the libcurl_vendor control file after rosdep returned two apt packages on one line.
errors.root_cause: The packaging loop preserved each rosdep output line as one dependency instead of splitting whitespace-delimited package names.
errors.correction: Normalize non-comment rosdep output into one Debian package token per line.
errors.prevention: Regression-test tokenization of multi-package rosdep results before control-file generation.

errors.symptom: The audit reported dpkg-deb was killed by SIGPIPE although all 244 packages had been generated correctly.
errors.root_cause: grep -q exited after its first match and closed dpkg-deb output under pipefail.
errors.correction: Capture each package listing once and run path checks against the captured text.
errors.prevention: Prohibit short-circuit grep directly downstream of dpkg-deb in audit scripts.

errors.symptom: A corrected audit run had to recompile the ROS graph because packaging had already deleted build and log state before downstream gates ran.
errors.root_cause: Cleanup was coupled to successful Debian package creation instead of successful completion of the full release pipeline.
errors.correction: Defer cleanup until packaging, audit, signing, SBOM, install, and smoke-test gates all pass.
errors.prevention: Regression-test that cleanup occurs only after the PASS marker is written.

errors.symptom: The active ClickUp task was briefly observed in Closed while the native release and timer were still active.
errors.root_cause: Status mutations lacked an explicit terminal precondition and mandatory post-write verification of status and date_closed.
errors.correction: Restored and verified in progress with date_closed null, synchronized completed stages, and published verified ClickUp comment 90150245337520.
errors.prevention: Require terminal gate evidence, read-before/write/read-after status handling, automatic non-terminal restoration, and an incident comment for mismatches.

errors.symptom: GitHub connector returned HTTP 403 when creating the approved issue.
errors.root_cause: The connector integration lacked issue creation access to the repository.
errors.correction: Used the authenticated GitHub CLI fallback.
errors.prevention: Check connector write permission and use the documented CLI fallback without repeating the failed mutation.

errors.symptom: ClickUp comment creation returned INVALID_ARGUMENT with both default and explicit assignee requests.
errors.root_cause: The ClickUp connector comment endpoint is not accepting this workspace/task request; task reads, status updates, and timers succeed.
errors.correction: Use the authenticated ClickUp interface fallback and retain the full checkpoint in the linked GitHub Issue until connector posting is repaired.
errors.prevention: Attempt one standard request and one documented variant only, then switch to the verified fallback and read activity after posting.

errors.symptom: Draft text remaining in the ClickUp editor was incorrectly reported as a published comment, while the comment API returned zero comments.
errors.root_cause: Verification searched for text on the page but did not require editor clearing, a separate authored Activity entry, and a fresh comment read.
errors.correction: Submitted with the supported keyboard shortcut and verified editor clearing, an authored Activity entry, and comment ID 90150245276115 through the API.
errors.prevention: Require all three publication checks in SCRUMNEO.md before reporting success or changing a task to blocked.
invalidated_evidence: Earlier claims that the process 1.4.0 and 1.5.0 ClickUp comments were published

errors.symptom: The first commit-bound metadata-gate invocation used an incorrectly expanded 40-character SHA and git could not resolve VERSION at that revision.
errors.root_cause: A short commit display value was manually expanded instead of resolving it with git rev-parse.
errors.correction: Resolved HEAD with git rev-parse and reran the metadata gate successfully on 1d978fab88ed2b15aeb62f2c48b2d631d1b61d57.
errors.prevention: Always obtain full commit identifiers programmatically with git rev-parse before commit-bound gates.

errors.symptom: The first builder probe using default SSH authentication returned Permission denied.
errors.root_cause: The builder uses the dedicated local key id_ed25519_rpi106, which was not selected by the default SSH attempt.
errors.correction: Selected C:/Users/kkova/.ssh/id_ed25519_rpi106 and verified builder access.
errors.prevention: Record and reuse the dedicated key path for rpi@192.168.144.106 in release checkpoints.

errors.symptom: The builder repository was cloned correctly, but release-rpi.sh was resolved from the SSH login directory and the pipeline did not create a pid or exit record.
errors.root_cause: Windows OpenSSH command-line argument transport did not preserve the intended multi-line shell command and working-directory context.
errors.correction: Stream native start and polling scripts through SSH stdin to bash -s.
errors.prevention: Regression-test stdin transport for both dispatcher start and state polling.

errors.symptom: Remote start stopped before creating a build process with true carriage-return and rc unbound-variable errors.
errors.root_cause: Windows PowerShell emitted CRLF over stdin and the nested double-quoted sh -c command expanded rc in the outer set -u shell.
errors.correction: Strip carriage returns before bash -s and use a background subshell with local exit-code capture.
errors.prevention: Regression-test CRLF normalization and prohibit nested nohup sh -c in the dispatcher.

errors.root_cause: The comment connector rejected the task request although task updates succeeded.
errors.correction: Stored the checkpoint in the ClickUp task description and retained the GitHub evidence link.
errors.prevention: Prefer task-description checkpoint updates until comment creation is verified for this workspace.

reusable_improvements: Exact source and evidence-bound release workflow
